## How every build runs
- One loop, five phases: 01 Scope (spec + acceptance criteria), 02 Generate (coding agent implements), 03 Review (independent agent on another model family audits the diff), 04 Patch (flagged issues fixed before merge), 05 Ship (deploy with automated tests green).
- Routing per phase: OpenCode orchestrates; Claude reasons and reviews; DeepSeek generates fast; Gemini handles multimodal analysis.

## Engineering notes (authored)
- Shipping a catalogue that sells (Sep 2026): faceted search narrows, compare decides, 60+ spec rows answer before the phone rings; RAG over unmodelled data is faster confusion.
- What an ERP teaches about data integrity (Sep 2026): one shared truth via RLS and a single source of record; priority triage only works when the queue is trustworthy.
- Building with agentic loops (Aug 2026): scope, delegate to a coding agent, independent reviewer on a different model family before done.
- Multi-model routing (Jul 2026): code generation is not code review is not architecture planning; route per phase.
- Offline-first lessons (Jun 2026): queue writes locally, sync on return; design for the network drop, not the happy path.
